This '''[[World Devastator]]''' was a former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="DEII" />

==History==
The Devastator survived the sabotage of the collective system of the deadly factory ship fleets at the conclusion of the [[Battle of Calamari]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. It was reprogrammed by the New Republic, who used it to devour and recycle derelict space craft in orbit of [[Da Soocha V]].<ref name="DEII" /> However, the ship, and any other World Devastators that the New Republic captured, ended up scrapped after a public outcry.<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Dark Horse Comics]] editor [[Bob Cooper]] indicates that this World Devastator was scuttled above Da Soocha V.<ref name="Letters">[[Empire's End 1|''Empire's End'' 1]], letter pages</ref>
